title: Density of C_c^∞ fields supported in Ω in L¹(Ω; ℝⁿ)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open, and let c : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ be Lebesgue integrable on Ω. Then for every δ > 0 there is a C^∞ field b : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ with compact support and tsupport b ⊆ Ω such that ∫_Ω |c(w) − b(w)| dw < δ. Here C^∞ means ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (smooth, not analytic), and the integral is for Lebesgue measure on ℝⁿ = Eucl n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (c : Eucl n → Eucl n), IsOpen Ω → IntegrableOn c Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ b : Eucl n → Eucl n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b ∧ HasCompactSupport b ∧ tsupport b ⊆ Ω ∧ ∫ w in Ω, ‖c w - b w‖ < δ
